name: macro-progress
description: Displays prepared nutrition progress with a native ProgressView and an adaptive value layout.
usage:
MacroProgress(
    "Protein",
    value: Text("96 g"),
    target: Text("130 g"),
    progress: 96.0 / 130.0,
    systemImage: "fish.fill"
)
.registryTint(.indigo)
accessibility: When horizontal space is limited, ViewThatFits moves the prepared values below the label.
It combines the label with one localized progress phrase and does not use tint alone for meaning.
